decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The single-family dwellinghouse is considered to be of an insufficient size with regards the Council's residential conversion guidelines for sub-division, and the proposal would therefore result in the unacceptable loss of a small house suitable for single-family occupation for which there is an identified need in the borough, contrary to policy H.3.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003).

Condition : 2 - The conversion of the single-family dwellinghouse into two self-contained flats would represent a cramped overdevelopment of the site, which would fail to meet the Council's standards for internal space provision, and would fail to provide any private amenity space for the first floor flat. The proposal would therefore result in substandard living accommodation, detrimental to residential amenity of the future occupants, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1, H.3.4 and H.4.1 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003).

Condition : 3 - The proposed hip-to-gable roof extension, rear roof extension and ground and first floor rear extensions, by nature of their size, bulk and top-heavy appearance would be detrimental to the character of the original building and the streetscene, and would result in loss of light to the rear of the adjoining property, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.3.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003).

Condition : 4 - The proposal fails to provide any off-street parking provision in accordance with the Council's Parking Standards, which may result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to policy T.1.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003)
description: Erection of a part two storey part single storey rear extension, roof extension and conversion of dwellinghouse into 2 self contained flats.
